tasks.short: Investigate water storage, discharge or compliance issues

steps.what: Define the actual water investigation question and evidence needed
inputs: actual water storage, discharge, pollution or permit concern
current approved investigation procedures

steps.what: Review current permit records, site history and actual water monitoring results
inputs: existing actual monitoring results with location, time, method and units
current permits and site records
investigation scope and evidence plan
outputs: checked existing evidence and missing information

steps.what: Conduct the actual site investigation or oversee staff collecting required water evidence
inputs: checked existing evidence and missing information
investigation scope and evidence plan
actual site conditions and staff findings
outputs: actual investigation observations and evidence limitations

steps.what: Capture actual observations and verified staff evidence with source references
inputs: actual investigation observations and evidence limitations
actual sample or field-record references

steps.what: Evaluate the actual evidence and write justified findings and unresolved regulatory questions
inputs: complete factual investigation evidence record
checked existing evidence and missing information
applicable current permit conditions

steps.what: Assemble the investigation report from verified evidence and actual findings
inputs: human-authored investigation findings and limitations
complete factual investigation evidence record

steps.what: Approve the completed investigation report after checking source support and limits
inputs: complete water investigation report
complete factual investigation evidence record

steps.what: Save the approved investigation report in the case record
inputs: approved final water investigation report

tasks.design: Configure monitoring and case views in the water records system {OPS_SYSTEM} and an evidence-linked report template in {DOCS}. The specialist conducts or oversees the actual investigation, captures findings and judges the evidence; configuration reduces retrieval and assembly only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewing existing monitoring records and assembling a source-linked report can add work around an investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native location/time filters and report templates can reuse actual records without creating observations.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete sampling, conflicting evidence and permit applicability require competent human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist recognises when available records do not answer the actual site question.

ambition.what: Revisit an investigation when new verified monitoring evidence arrives.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for site records, field access and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: water monitoring records can be filtered by site and time and reused in evidence-linked document templates.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenario arithmetic, not measured investigation baselines.
Existing monitoring results have actual locations, times, methods and units. New field work remains in s3 and actual capture in s4; missing laboratory work is not free.
Native filters and templates first; findings and regulatory interpretation remain human.
No external regulatory submission is assumed merely because an internal investigation report exists. Same-system save has no saving.
unknowns: Coverage and traceability of monitoring records
research_questions: Which source-retrieval and report-assembly work remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check the completed investigation report against actual evidence

incremental.description: Maintain monitoring filters and case-report source mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved final water investigation report; edits return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 7.5 retrieval hours +4 assembly hours =11.5. Upkeep 1.5 gives central net 10%; three extra hours resolving mismatched monitoring records gives high 7%. Low zero if native workflows already cover this work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define actual water supply, conservation and compliance goals and binding constraints
inputs: actual watershed programme objectives
current applicable permit and operating constraints

steps.what: Discuss actual operational options and trade-offs with watershed operators and affected colleagues
inputs: checked strategy goals and constraints
participants' actual operating limits and concerns
outputs: human-defined operating options and actual stakeholder constraints

steps.what: Check actual watershed supply, demand, quality and conservation data for the planning period
inputs: existing actual watershed monitoring and demand records
source metadata, units and uncertainty
human-defined operating options and actual stakeholder constraints
outputs: checked strategy dataset with explicit uncertainty and gaps

steps.what: Run approved watershed operating scenarios and inspect supply and conservation outcomes
inputs: checked strategy dataset with explicit uncertainty and gaps
human-defined operating options and actual stakeholder constraints
validated watershed model and approved scenario assumptions
outputs: reproducible scenario outcomes with assumptions and sensitivity limits

steps.what: Choose a defensible watershed operations strategy and explain its trade-offs and unresolved risks
inputs: reproducible scenario outcomes with assumptions and sensitivity limits
checked strategy goals and constraints
human-defined operating options and actual stakeholder constraints

steps.what: Prepare the strategy plan from the chosen rationale, scenario results and actual operating conditions
inputs: human-chosen strategy and actual rationale
reproducible scenario outcomes with assumptions and sensitivity limits

steps.what: Approve the completed strategy plan against its source assumptions and chosen goals
inputs: complete watershed strategy plan
checked strategy goals and constraints

steps.what: Save the approved proposed watershed strategy
inputs: approved final proposed watershed strategy

tasks.design: Configure watershed data views in {DATA_PLATFORM} and reusable scenarios in the existing hydrological planning application {OTHER}. A template in {DOCS} carries the results and human-chosen rationale into a proposed strategy; it does not issue operating commands or decide compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated data preparation, scenario setup and plan formatting can delay comparison of human-defined options.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning tools can rerun validated models and scenario templates against checked data.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain future conditions and conflicting conservation, supply and stakeholder goals require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can reject an apparently efficient scenario that rests on implausible assumptions or unacceptable trade-offs.

ambition.what: Reassess operating options as actual watershed conditions change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for monitoring data, model access and operator consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: hydrological planning tools can repeat validated model scenarios and sensitivity calculations, while people choose objectives and operating strategies.

assumptions: All effort shares are provisional scenarios, not measured watershed-planning baselines.
An appropriate validated model and actual monitoring records already exist. Developing a new scientific model is outside this configuration estimate and must be separately counted if needed.
Human options and constraints originate in s1 and s2; the specialist captures the chosen rationale in s5 and actual plan in s6.
Native scenario functions first; no language model chooses operating rules or interprets missing compliance requirements.
The proposed strategy is saved for authorised governance, not automatically implemented. Same-system save has no saving.
research_questions: Which repeated scenario setup can be reused without hiding model uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Check final proposed strategy against chosen goals

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, approved scenarios and model-version checks

approvals.approved_version: approved final proposed watershed strategy; changes return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10 data-preparation hours +12 repeated scenario hours +2 plan-assembly hours =24. Three upkeep hours give central net 21%; five additional hours checking unusual hydrological conditions gives high 16%. Low zero if existing tools already cover this or no reusable validated model exists.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual detention, storm drain or flood-control design and identify its current revision
inputs: actual hydraulic design drawings and model revision
existing design register
outputs: verified current design package and referenced drawings

steps.what: Verify the design assumptions, site conditions and applicable engineering review criteria
inputs: verified current design package and referenced drawings
actual site survey and documented design assumptions
approved review criteria
outputs: checked review basis with unresolved assumptions flagged

steps.what: Check hydraulic calculations and approved design scenarios using the existing analysis model
inputs: checked review basis with unresolved assumptions flagged
actual design model and approved calculation methods
outputs: reproducible calculation checks and flagged deviations

steps.what: Evaluate whether the hydraulic design is justified and identify changes or specialist questions
inputs: reproducible calculation checks and flagged deviations
checked review basis with unresolved assumptions flagged
verified current design package and referenced drawings

steps.what: Capture actual review comments, drawing references and unresolved design questions
inputs: human-authored engineering review conclusions
verified current design package and referenced drawings

steps.what: Approve the completed review record against actual drawings, calculations and evidence limits
inputs: complete hydraulic design review record
reproducible calculation checks and flagged deviations

steps.what: Save the approved hydraulic design review record
inputs: approved final hydraulic review record

tasks.design: Configure current drawing links in {DOCS} and reusable calculation checks in the existing hydraulic design and analysis tools {OTHER}. The specialist verifies assumptions, evaluates the design and captures actual comments; the tool supplies calculations rather than an engineering acceptance decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Identifying current drawings and repeating established calculation checks can add effort around design evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design revision references and validated analysis scenarios can repeat known checks.
tasks.still_hard: Model assumptions, unusual flow conditions and site-specific failure consequences require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist recognises when a successful calculation does not establish a suitable design.

ambition.what: Repeat checked calculations when a design revision changes relevant inputs.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–4 for drawings, analysis tools and design-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: hydraulic analysis tools can repeat approved calculations and design document systems can link current revisions; engineering acceptance remains a human decision.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured design-review effort.
Actual drawings, site data and a usable analysis model already exist; recreating an absent model or survey is separate counted work.
The specialist checks assumptions in s2 and captures actual comments in s5. No model infers site geometry or legal compliance.
Native revision and calculation features first. Same-system save has no saving.
Saving a review record does not grant construction permission or release a design.
research_questions: Which established checks can repeat with traceable inputs rather than a new engineering judgement?

already_counted.description: Check the complete hydraulic review record

incremental.description: Maintain validated check scenarios and drawing-version links

approvals.approved_version: approved final hydraulic review record; edits return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 8 drawing-retrieval hours +10 repeated-calculation hours =18. Two upkeep hours give central net 16%; four additional hours resolving model/revision differences gives high 12%. Low zero if the current design tools already provide this.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present water resource proposals to public groups

steps.what: Prepare presentation figures and proposal materials from the actual checked water resource proposal
inputs: actual checked proposal, supporting figures and limitations
approved public disclosure boundaries

steps.what: Choose a clear explanation suited to the actual government, public interest or community audience
inputs: complete draft proposal presentation
actual audience concerns and meeting purpose
outputs: complete audience-adapted presentation with human-written explanation

steps.what: Approve the complete final presentation including figures, claims, uncertainty and disclosure suitability
inputs: complete audience-adapted presentation with human-written explanation
actual checked proposal, supporting figures and limitations

steps.what: Present the approved water resource proposal to the actual outside audience
inputs: approved final public proposal presentation
actual government or community audience
steps.handoff_to: government, public interest or community group

steps.what: Answer actual audience questions and discuss concerns without inventing commitments
inputs: actual audience questions and concerns
actual checked proposal, supporting figures and limitations
outputs: actual discussion outcomes and agreed or unresolved follow-up

steps.what: Capture actual public responses, questions and follow-up commitments after the presentation
inputs: actual discussion outcomes and agreed or unresolved follow-up

steps.what: Approve the completed follow-up record against actual discussion outcomes
inputs: complete actual public-presentation follow-up record

steps.what: Save the approved actual presentation follow-up record
inputs: approved final public-presentation follow-up record

tasks.design: Configure approved figure exports in {BI} and reusable public-presentation layouts in {DOCS}. The specialist writes the audience explanation, checks the complete version and presents it, then records actual public questions and commitments after the discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chart and slide formatting can consume preparation time before public presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native chart exports and reusable layouts can populate checked proposal facts without generating a public position.
tasks.still_hard: Public concerns, trust and explaining uncertainty require live human communication.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can recognise a misunderstood proposal and explain its practical limits without promising an unsupported outcome.

ambition.what: Prepare a suitable presentation for another public audience using the same checked proposal.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–4 for disclosure review and public-engagement consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: presentation templates and chart exports can reuse checked figures while people retain audience explanation and live discussion.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured public-engagement baselines.
An actual checked proposal and its supporting figures already exist; this task presents that proposal rather than generating new engineering evidence.
s2 counts actual explanation authoring; s6 counts actual response capture after delivery. No transcript or free upstream note is assumed.
Native templates first. No saving in delivery, public discussion, actual record capture or the same-system save.
Later publication or mailing is a separate action requiring its own completed payload and gate, with no saving assumed here.
research_questions: How much figure and slide formatting remains after native templates?

already_counted.description: Check the complete public presentation against the actual proposal

incremental.description: Maintain approved figure exports and presentation layouts

approvals.approved_version: approved final public proposal presentation; revised content returns to s3
approved final actual follow-up record; edits return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only material assembly changes: 20*(1-0.60)=8 gross hours. One upkeep hour gives central net 7%; two additional hours correcting audience-specific figure layouts gives high 5%. Low zero if native layouts already cover preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: field and monitoring staff: produce actual traceable evidence
hydraulic engineers: validate model assumptions and design conclusions
operators and public groups: clarify real constraints and concerns
role.ambitious_version: A water resource specialist with faster evidence and report preparation, retaining field judgement, defensible strategy choices and direct public communication.
